jev-view.what: Jev jev-1.13.0, DocumentView as state, one Choice over 18 leaves

jev-chunks.what: Jev jev-1.13.0, raw page text, <=8 chunks of ~1,500 tokens, mean of per-chunk Choices (no docrooter)

ultrabert-dev-logistic.what: UltraBERT-Embed-150M view embeddings + logistic regression trained on all 51 dev docs, C in {1, 10, 100, 1000} by inner leave-one-out on dev (trained on dev, tested on another corpus)

ultrabert-bge-dev-ensemble.what: Zero-shot UltraBERT-view and bge-view leaf distributions mixed, weight in {0, .25, .5, .75, 1} chosen by leave-one-out on the 51 dev docs (tested on another corpus)
